name: uc41_display
notes: Universal Controller 4.1 (Tip Charger) display - do NOT flash onto a Plasma StandAlone panel. 4.1.42B TEST BUILD: under plasma the tip sensor reads 0-85 with tips in and 10-156 with tips out (overlapping), so it can no longer stop plasma - that caused 4.1.41B's 2-5 s on / 1 s pump cycling. Now: tips in fires plasma, the plasma timer ends the cycle, and the next cycle needs the tips seen OUT with plasma off. Safety: watchdog cuts plasma at plasma time + 5 s whatever happens (blinking 888), relay read-back check, STOP / serial stop / Test Plasma OFF end the cycle. Keeps 4.1.41B main-loop fixes (smoothed power/vac flow, timer shut-offs, pump stays on). On-screen label still reads 4.1.38 (graphics unchanged). Program only (.4XE), uSD untouched.
